description: This file defines the LocalTaskDefault class, which implements local task plugin functionality within Drupal, including route handling, caching, and active state management.

classes.name: LocalTaskDefault
classes.description: Default object used for LocalTaskPlugins, managing route parameters, title, weight, options, active state, and cache settings.

methods.name: getRouteName
methods.description: Returns the route name from plugin definition.

methods.name: getRouteParameters
methods.description: Retrieves route parameters, combining raw parameters, route variables, and plugin definition.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the local task, possibly translatable.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the task, defaulting to -10 for root tab or 0 otherwise.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns options for the local task, adding 'is-active' class if active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active state of the task.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Returns whether the task is active.

methods.name: routeProvider
methods.description: Provides the route provider service, caching it for reuse.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags associated with the plugin.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts associated with the plugin.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age, defaulting to permanent.
